tips.text: Build a 1-1-1 Amp before the Operator fights; the starter Mote Amp makes them slow, and it need not be Gilded.
Restart the stage if Void Sling does not stun him; the bug clears on retry.
Wait for the stun before Transference; going in too early can leave you inside an invisible Umbra.
Put away any channelled Exalted Weapon before you Void Sling into him.
If the movement buttons vanish on the black-and-gold path, use a gamepad or play that section on PC through cross-save.
Expect a story gate rather than a grind; the Operator-only fight is the one hard part.
